method: Exact solid intersections at <=0.5 mm hardware increments; relative-pose cache and bounding-box rejection. Covers angled axle extraction and parking, roller and motor removal, the chassis slide and tray withdrawal, and lower bearing hardware removal. Sampled geometry, not a continuous proof. Motor-screw path subsequently rechecked separately at <=0.5 mm over 60–100%; all other geometry/tracks remain unchanged. See motor_screw_parking_validation.

motor_screw_parking_validation.method: Rechecked all pairs involving motor screws over the complete affected interval at <=0.5 mm translation increments. Only their Z extraction changes, from 18 to 21 mm; geometry, all other tracks and Y envelopes are unchanged.
